key_insight: OrchRM learns a reward model for multi-agent orchestration from self-supervised win-lose pairs built from intermediate execution artifacts, avoiding expensive human labels and sub-agent rollouts.
engineering_relevance: It enables more efficient training and test-time scaling of LLM multi-agent orchestrators, with reported gains of up to 10x lower token usage and up to 8% higher accuracy.
method: Construct win-lose orchestration pairs from intermediate artifacts of multi-agent runs.
Train a Bradley-Terry reward model at the orchestration level rather than the sub-agent level.
Use the learned reward to guide orchestrator training and test-time scaling.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports consistent improvements across mathematical reasoning, web QA, and multi-hop reasoning, including up to 10x token savings and up to 8% accuracy gains.
watch_item: Performance may depend on the quality of intermediate artifacts and the specific MAS setup, so robustness across diverse orchestration patterns should be validated carefully.
